b6238d208fc04db67b2845a87dab34fe19e7f147.sourceText: 第二个仰角在雷达自身系中计算，单位同样是度。当前窗口为(-28°,33°)，另外 `abs(z_L)<0.2 m` 可绕过该窗口。MID360 官方标称垂直视场为 **-7°～52°**；这与当前软件窗口不同，但窗口还承担候选筛选，不能据此直接判定两项数值必须替换。[Livox 官方规格](https://www.livoxtech.com/mid-360/specs)
b6238d208fc04db67b2845a87dab34fe19e7f147.translatedText: The second elevation angle is calculated in the radar's own coordinate system, also in degrees\. The current window is (\-28°, 33°), and additionally `abs(z_L)<0.2 m` can bypass this window\. The MID360's official specified vertical field of view is **\-7° to 52°**; this differs from the current software window, but the window also serves for candidate screening, so it cannot be directly concluded that the two values must be replaced based on this\.[Livox official specifications](https://www.livoxtech.com/mid-360/specs)
